title: An Afternoon at GitHub Copilot Dev Days
subtitle: Microsoft Toronto · GitHub Copilot Dev Days
paragraphs: I attended GitHub Copilot Dev Days at Microsoft’s Toronto office. Most attendees were working professionals, and I was one of a small number of students there.

That made it a useful change from university events. Being in the office and hearing how people worked gave me a glimpse of what a regular commute and working life at a larger company might look like.

As a student, it’s easy to feel overwhelmed by the pace of new tools. Seeing them demonstrated in a professional setting helped put things in perspective: what people were actually using, what the tools could do, and where I could start learning.

I learned more about AI agents and orchestration in VS Code, which I later found useful in my work at the stealth startup. It was a small event, but a worthwhile introduction to professional development outside the classroom.
